title: The rwalld daemon must be disabled on AIX.
check_content:
From the command prompt, execute the following command: 
# grep "^rwalld[[:blank:]]" /etc/inetd.conf

If there is any output from the command, this is a finding.
fixtext:
In "/etc/inetd.conf", comment out the "rwalld" entry by running command: 
# chsubserver -r inetd -C /etc/inetd.conf -d -v 'rwalld' -p 'udp'

Restart inetd:
# refresh -s inetd
VulnDiscussion: The rwalld service allows remote users to broadcast system wide messages. The service runs as root and should be disabled unless absolutely necessary to prevent attacks.
